capabilities: Generate formatted business letters from note frontmatter and body
Export letters as PDF on desktop and mobile
Print letters via the OS print dialog
Configure DIN 5008 and modern layouts, styles, and sender profiles
Scaffold letter frontmatter fields into a note
disambiguation: Not a letterhead or stationery design tool; it generates complete, paginated business letters from note content.
extras: Detailed reference, getting-started, troubleshooting, and theming docs live in external documentation pages, not in the README; releases carry Sigstore/SLSA build-provenance attestations (except 1.6.5/1.6.6, which ship checksums instead); AGPL-3.0 licensed and fully offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce a properly formatted business letter (DIN 5008 or international layout) as a PDF from a note.
summary: Letter generator that turns a note's frontmatter and body into a DIN 5008 or modern business letter and exports it as PDF or prints it on paper.
